hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; [ -f data/raw/customers.csv ] && [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" != true ] || exit 0; { echo 'Stop hook: dbt build must pass, check row_counts must print 10000 and check accuracy_clean 71 (plus or minus 2).'; uv run dbt build --quiet && uv run check row_counts && uv run check accuracy_clean; } >&2 || exit 2
